analytics.noDataLetter: Tracking your emotions is the first step towards understanding yourself. How about coloring your diary this coming month?

analytics.letterHighPositivity: What a radiant month! You spent %{{percent}} of your days with high energy and serenity. Keep this wonderful vibe going into the new month! ✨
analytics.letterSadNotice: You felt blue on {{count}} days this month. Acknowledging your feelings and writing them down is truly precious. Wishing you brighter skies ahead... 🌸
analytics.letterStressedNotice: You navigated through challenging and stressful moments. Remember, even the wildest storms eventually clear up. Give yourself extra grace and rest 🌿
